about.label: About
about.title:
Built on curiosity.
Grounded in engineering.
paragraphs: At Samsung, I contribute to SmartThings on iOS and watchOS app. My work spans architecture, state management, performance, and testing.

Outside work, I build projects like CFTracker and an interactive React Native chart library. Competitive programming is another part of my practice: breaking down difficult problems and finding a better way through.

highlights: Contributing to the SmartThings iOS app, with 10M+ downloads, using Swift, UIKit, SwiftUI, and Combine within an MVVM-C architecture.
Develop the SmartThings watchOS app as the primary owner on the Bangladesh team, using SwiftUI.
Improve architecture and maintainability by reducing duplicate logic, migrating ReactiveSwift to Combine, and transitioning UIKit views to SwiftUI.
Achieved 90%+ test coverage for ViewModels and internal state management stores using XCTest.
Fixed **10+ memory leaks** with Instruments, reducing memory buildup by approximately **23%** over repeated use.
Reduced a performance-critical function from O(N×M) to O(N+M), bringing execution time from approximately **140 ms to under 50 ms**. Optimized debug logging from approximately 2 s to 50 ms.
Built proofs of concept with WatchKit, HealthKit, WidgetKit, and Core ML, and resolved **150+ bugs**, including critical production issues.
Built the React frontend from scratch for a SaaS product helping Amazon FBA sellers discover products and analyze sales.
Implemented a queue system to use third-party APIs efficiently.
Integrated Stripe payments and developed WebSocket and REST APIs.

items.name: CFTracker
paragraphs: A Codeforces practice and progress tracking app used by thousands of users, with 40+ GitHub stars.
React frontend, a Go and PostgreSQL backend, and a separate Next.js data collection service. GitHub Actions automate storage of API responses to reduce repeated requests.

items.name: React Native Chart Library
paragraphs: Five interactive chart components with customizable labels, overlays, and tooltips, built using Skia and Reanimated.
Implemented overscan rendering, gesture-driven panning, custom geometry, and touch selection.
